messages:
maya_support: Heads-up — Acme (acct: acme-inc) hit a 400 + schema validation error when using function-calling. They reported request id req_0a1b2c3d4e and also noticed higher tail latency (~1.2s/token). Pushing repro details here.

liam_eng: Can you paste the exact curl they ran and the full response body? Need request id + full response for triage. @ezra_sre for infra logs.

maya_support: Pasting the curl they ran (customer redacted key). Response body below as they provided it.

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Please summarize this document."}],"functions":[{"name":"summarize","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["summary"]}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

Response (400):
```json
{"error":{"type":"structured_output_validation_failed","message":"output schema mismatch: required property 'summary' missing","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d4e"}}
```

ezra_sre: I pulled logs for req_0a1b2c3d4e. Validation failed at output-postprocess step: "output schema mismatch: property 'summary' missing". Also seeing a CPU/GPU tail latency spike on host gpu-13 around 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z — the token gen time jumped to ~1.2s for several requests. Attaching log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-15T14:22:10Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d4e stage=postprocess error=validation_failed details="missing property 'summary' in function response" host=gpu-13
[2026-03-15T14:22:11Z] host=gpu-13 token_time_ms=1180
```

liam_eng: From the curl payload the function schema requires property named "summary". My guess: the model or the customer function returned a body with a different key (e.g., "result"), which trips validation. Two vectors to repro: model-generated function_call returning wrong key OR SDK-side mapping bug.

nina_pse: Also note customer mentioned intermittent 401s earlier today — if SDK retries or falls back to a different path that could change invocation semantics. Maya, did they include the raw verbose output from curl (headers+status)?

maya_support: They ran `curl -v` and pasted the headers; auth header present in all attempts. I asked them to run a minimal, deterministic repro and to include the raw function-call output (use experimental flag). Requested steps: request id list, curl -v, sdk version, region, and full response bodies. I gave them this minimal repro to run:

```bash
# minimal repro (customer to run, replace $KEY)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: The quick brown fox."}],"functions":[{"name":"summarize","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["summary"]}}],"function_call":"auto"}&experimental=structured_output' | jq .
```

liam_eng: For local repro I'll try forcing the model to return a function call with a different key to see if validation catches it. Also will try with our SDK v2.1.3 to check mapping logic.

maya_support: Customer agreed to upload a debug bundle. Asked them to include: list of request_ids, curl -v output, sdk version, region, timestamps, and a short recording of the SDK behavior if possible.

deploy-bot: debug-bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-debug/acme-inc/debug-1802345678.tar.gz (internal link)

ezra_sre: I'll tail logs for gpu-13 and set an alert for token_time_ms > 800ms. If we see sustained spikes I'll escalate infra. For now, triage steps: (1) confirm whether function response contained "result" vs "summary", (2) check SDK mapping versions, (3) reproduce with minimal curl.

liam_eng: I'll open a quick PR to add a tolerant fallback mapping for function outputs (map "result"->"summary" if schema expects "summary"). Will include unit tests against the sample from the bundle and ping ops when ready.

maya_support: Thanks — I'll coordinate with the customer and post back with the debug bundle contents and any additional request ids. Marking this as high-priority for the next 24h. :hourglass:
